headline: Maui Planning Commission

meeting.summary: The commission sought a closed Lahaina site visit, approved a beach park graywater permit, and deferred a resort case to January 28.
meeting.recap: Staff said public attendance was impractical because the area remains closed for security and debris removal.[[0:06:36]] Six commissioners voted in favor of the request.[[0:18:14]] The Department of Water Supply sought a coastal zone permit for a graywater (used shower and sink water) system at a Central Maui beach park.[[0:18:44]] The county planner said the system would save 14.4 million gallons of water a year.[[0:48:07]] The commission approved the permit.[[1:15:09]] In a resort contested case (a court-like hearing), the intervenors' lawyer asked Commissioner Ward to step aside.[[1:26:30]] Commissioner Ward will seek a Board of Ethics opinion before taking part.[[1:28:29]] The applicant said the project now includes 137 new guest rooms in two expanded wings.[[1:49:07]] They added a condition requiring a carbon footprint calculation and a plan to offset it.[[3:15:13]] They voted to add new storm water language to condition 15.[[3:38:37]] They added a condition for a plan to let the beach move inland while protecting burials.[[4:37:20]] The case was deferred to January 28.[[4:48:27]]
meeting.next: Staff will contact commissioners to schedule a date for the site visit. Review of the resort case conditions will pick up with traffic and roadways.
